transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Okay, so, let's start. Um, this is the, the second product sync on the speaker. Today, materials, then the app, then, um, packaging.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: Before we start, did everyone get the survey link? I put it in the chat.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: I did it yesterday. It took like three minutes.

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: Mine too.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Good. So, materials. Industrial Designer, you had the two options.

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: Yeah. Option one is the brushed aluminium front. It looks great, but it's heavy and it's, I'd say, almost six euros more per unit. Option two is the fabric mesh, like the competitor's, and it's light and, um, also acoustically transparent.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: Is it, uh, does it get dirty easily?

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: Not really. You can wipe it. The grey one at least. Light colours would be a problem.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: Honestly the mesh sells better in the, in the surveys. People associate it with home and warmth. Aluminium reads as office.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: So are we going with the mesh?

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: I'd say yes.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: Fine by me. I don't have a stake.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Okay. Decision, fabric mesh, not aluminium.

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: Then I need samples. I'll order the mesh samples from the supplier. They said it takes about three days, so I'd, I'd like to order today. I'll place the order by Friday at the latest.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Friday the thirteenth, fine.

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: And I'll update the cost sheet with the new price once you give me the quote.

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: I'll send you the quote as soon as I get it.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Good, so I'll update the cost sheet. I'll do that when the quote is in.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: Can I give the survey summary now? It's quick.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: So there were a hundred and forty responses. Um, eighty percent want voice control. Sixty percent say they would pay extra for, for better sound. And the, um, the app, a lot of people complained about onboarding on the competitor.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: Yeah, that's a known thing. Their pairing is awful.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: So I'll write up the whole survey and send the results to all of you. Tomorrow, I have to clean up the open text answers.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Tomorrow's the eleventh. Okay.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: Are we doing the voice assistant integration, by the way? Eighty percent want it.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: We talked about it. It's, it's four months of work. Not in this release.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: Yeah, I figured.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: It hurts, but okay.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Let's say it for the notes. We are not doing the voice assistant integration in this release. It's decided.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: Agreed.

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: Agreed.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: Yeah, okay.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: Um, on the app. Maybe we should compare our onboarding flow against two of the competitors? Like, screen-recordings and count the taps.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: That's a good idea. I could, you know, look at it but I'm not sure.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Let's not assign it. Take it as an idea.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: Were we okay on the speaker grille size? The mesh needs, um, a bit of a bigger opening.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: That's in my sketches already.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Good. Packaging, Marketing?

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: Um, so I think we want a minimal box. Recycled cardboard, one colour print. I could draft the brief for it. I'm not sure I'd have it before the, the twentieth, because of the campaign thing, but I'll try for the twentieth.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Okay. Packaging brief, Marketing, trying for the twentieth.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: Is there a cost budget for the box?

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: Not yet.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Let's set it with the brief.

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: Anything on certification? Like the radio approvals. We need it before we ship.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Yes, we do. Hmm. Who owns the certification paperwork? I'm assuming it's, it's engineering, but we don't have anyone in this call from there.

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: It's not me. I only do the enclosure.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: Not marketing.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: Don't know.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Okay, nobody. It's open.

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: Alright.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: Anybody up for lunch after this? There's the new place on the corner.

transcript.speaker: User Interface
transcript.text: Yes, please.

transcript.speaker: Industrial Designer
transcript.text: I'm in.

transcript.speaker: Project Manager
transcript.text: Sure. Okay, that's it. Thanks everyone.

transcript.speaker: Marketing
transcript.text: Thanks.

decisions.text: The prototype will use the cheaper fabric mesh instead of aluminium
The team will not do the voice-assistant integration in this release
